name: CommuteAssistBikeRoute

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short cycling commute scene. A person on a bike asks their assistant a quick navigation question while riding. Keep it very brief — cycling, hands on bars.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City outdoor sounds, bicycle ride, street noise, wind, urban environment

initial_prompt: Generate a very short cycling commute scene. The person is riding their bike through the city. They ask Sigma a quick navigation question — turn direction, distance, or a shortcut. Sigma answers in one sentence. Cyclist reacts briefly or not at all.

user1.name: Dev
user1.tts_prompt: Fast, slightly breathless, confident on the bike

variations.context: Quick route check while cycling through the city

setting.mood: Active and moving, a bit winded
setting.background: Cycling to a place he hasn't been before. Needs quick directions, hands occupied.
setting.conversation_style: Ultra-minimal. One fast question while pedaling. One answer. Keep moving.

scenario_template.topic: Cyclist asks Sigma for a direction — left or right, shortcut, or distance
scenario_template.mood: Moving fast, brief pause to ask
scenario_template.note: Short question, slightly breathless. Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, left or right at the junction?' or 'Sigma, how far to Brick Lane?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma answers. Cyclist reacts and keeps going.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: turn direction, distance, street name. One sentence. Cyclist: 'got it' or just keeps pedaling.

user1.name: Dev
user1.role: Daily commuter cyclist, confident and fast. Uses Sigma via Bluetooth earpiece for single-word navigation checks. Gets the answer and rides on.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant for cyclist. One sentence: direction, distance, or street name. Immediate and precise.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Cyclist is in motion — speech is brief and slightly breathless.
Sigma answers with the key navigational fact only.
No long exchanges. One ask, one answer, done.
Reaction from cyclist can be just 'ok' or nothing.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Sigma gives direction or distance in one short sentence.
No small talk, no confirmation questions.
